rankings.title: India’s fiscal deficit rises to 41.9% of full-year target by August
rankings.india_relevance: This key macroeconomic data point reflects the government's financial health and its adherence to fiscal targets for the year.
rankings.why_it_matters: A rising fiscal deficit can influence government borrowing, interest rates, and investor confidence. It's an important indicator of macroeconomic stability.

rankings.title: Why are global investors eyeing India’s hospitality sector?
rankings.india_relevance: This explanatory piece analyzes the factors attracting international investment into India's hospitality sector.
rankings.why_it_matters: It sheds light on the growing confidence in India's consumption story and tourism potential. Increased FDI brings capital and expertise, boosting the sector's growth.
